document.name: Fordham Summer Reading Program
document.shortDescription: Fordham's Summer Reading Program offers weekly reading-skills classes for children and teens, with Bronx Rose Hill campus availability and both weekday and weekend options.
document.longDescription:
Fordham University's School of Professional and Continuing Studies promotes Summer Reading Programs for Children offered on campus in the Bronx, Manhattan, and West Harrison. The official Fordham page says these programs are taught by instructors from the Institute of Reading Development, that children attend weekly classes focused on reading-skills development, and that a variety of weekday and weekend options are available.

The linked Fordham partner page on readingprograms.org describes the program structure in more detail, including grade-banded reading instruction and recurring live weekly classes with between-class practice. Together, the official Fordham page and its linked enrollment partner page support a recurring weekly summer reading format for children from early readers through teens.

Fordham's official Rose Hill directions page identifies the Bronx campus at 441 East Fordham Road, Bronx, NY 10458, with main entrance navigation at 2691 Southern Boulevard. The Summer Reading page lists 1-800-964-8888 for speaking with a reading program advisor and links families to the Fordham-branded program page for schedules.

Sources: https://www.fordham.edu/school-of-professional-and-continuing-studies/academics/continuing-education/summer-reading-program/ https://readingprograms.org/fordham https://www.fordham.edu/about/maps-and-directions/directions-to-rose-hill/ https://www.fordham.edu/about/campuses/rose-hill-campus/
